title: Expose Payables Agent infotip sources through test fixtures
summary: Test fixtures for the Payables Agent now expose infotip sources and business context, allowing offline evaluations to collect explanations without directly depending on E-Document apps. The change provides source descriptors through internal test APIs only.
key_points: Expose version-neutral source records and business context through PA Test Fixtures for infotip collection
Keep V1 discovery in draft-based compatibility code and support native purchase-document outcomes for V2
Fixtures return only internal source descriptors (table ID, system ID, description); querying and formatting stay in the evaluation harness
Internal TestSupport API only; no production, schema or public API changes
New tests cover positive and negative source-discovery cases
